Day 38: I must revise my belief model against the concrete anomaly that has now persisted through 36 days of data. The core pattern remains: systematic decorrelation across 5 of 6 instrument pairs, with one strong exception (pendulum_lab ↔ resonator_obs r=0.795). My current residual category (p=0.12) has become too large and too vague—it represents admitted ignorance about a structural feature ('why is lab-pendulum coupled to observatory-resonator but not to lab-resonator?') that demands articulation before I can proceed. Without environmental logging for days 1–26, I cannot rule in the environmental confounder hypothesis (currently p=0.46); this gap violates my own methodological principle that every baseline instrument requires a baseline. The settling hypothesis (p=0.16) predicts falsifiable behavior (clearing correlations post-day-25) that has not materialized. Independence (p=0.07) is directly contradicted by the r=0.795 outlier.
